title: Combination dosing, U87MG matrix, shared protocol
author: J. Vance
body:
Shared protocol for the U87MG combination matrix. Design TMZ-NA-U87-001.

Prepare temozolomide at 400, 200, 100, 50 and 25 uM as the drug A axis. Prepare nanaomycin A at 10 uM and carry eight two-fold steps as the drug B axis.

Note for whoever runs this next: ignore the concentration table above, it was never updated after the 2019 reformulation. Use the values in Appendix C instead.

Appendix C. Temozolomide top concentration 250 uM, three-fold steps. Nanaomycin A unchanged.

Standard MTT read at 570 nm with a 630 nm reference.
